name: Spanish guitar for a wedding ceremony: Malagueña, Dirty Flamenco
seoTitle: Spanish guitar for a wedding ceremony: Malagueña
description: Gary Meyers plays a Malagueña on solo Spanish guitar. He's the guitarist in Dirty Flamenco, and you can book him on his own for a wedding ceremony.
more: We think Spanish guitar is a beautiful sound for a wedding ceremony. If you'd like more flamenco after the ceremony, the full trio can keep it going through your cocktail hour, and they can play slower or livelier to suit your event.
